priceTarget: After fixed completed decision bar ending t, M5 close proxy at t+5m entry, M5 close proxy at t+5m+h exit; missing future labels tracked separately, not a selection condition; no broker fills
predictor: Nonlinear conditional categorical empirical-Bayes mean + up-probability per symbol/family/feature state/horizon, training only weeks 1-26; prior zero mean and Beta(1,1) up probability, fixed 16 pseudo-observations for conditional mean; class uncertainty and correct-sign classification. No WIDE_REGIME ridge or IPF1 online SGD, no closed study calls.
selection: Predecision posterior mean and two-sided 95% normal interval; directional opportunity only when posterior lower bound excludes zero and estimated adverse current-contract cost; otherwise ABSTAIN. Instrument and family ranking compares conservative expected EUR; no trade from indicators alone.
validation: Train first26 only with fully matured horizons; freeze all parameters for weeks27-39 selection; predeclare one (family,horizon) global policy only if selection weekly adverse NET EUR lower confidence bound > cash and positive vs prior 4h price-only benchmark using familywise Bonferroni for 7x2x2 comparisons. Remaining last13 globally exposed descriptive; never recombine favorable cells. 12 instruments always disclosed; no instrument cherry-pick.
costs: Extract original BDP1/AIP1 synchronized current-contract original bid/ask/commission EUR cost contexts ONLY with observation At < trainEnd; dynamic current min-notional and worst current min-margin, central/adverse modeled bps downstream of predictive score, swap/funding missing blocks admission. Conditionally modeled minimum-volume EUR payoff = current original source min-notional EUR * (signed M5 bid-like future log-return - original source current-term modeled scenario cost)/10000. Not historical executable bid/ask or native funded NET.
